lastResponse.text: First step: call nine one one now, because shaky and blurry vision can be an emergency. That’s nine… one… one. If you can still make one more call, try Old Town Clinic at 5-0-3… 2-2-8… 4-5-3-3. Ask if they can see you today for urgent insulin help. Address: 726 West Burnside Street.
originalTexts: First step: call **9-1-1** now, because shaky and blurry vision can be an emergency. That’s **nine… one… one**. If you can still make one more call, try Old Town Clinic at **5-0-3… 2-2-8… 4-5-3-3**. Ask if they can see you today for urgent insulin help. Address: **726 West Burnside Street**.
